dct_title_s: Flood Impact assessment of the Capital city of Kathmandu, Bagmati Province, Nepal as of 30 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240928NPL** This map illustrates the floods using the Spot-6 image acquired on 30 September 2024 at 14:20 local time (08:35 UTC). Within the analysed area of about 450 km², a total of about 8 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters. and about 4 km² of cropland seems to be inundated. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, about 46,000 people are exposed or living close to flooded areas. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified about 5,000 potentially affected structures within the analysed area. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
